project_name: NEXUS — Neural Executive System for Universal Support
design_archetype: Electric Cyber-Holographic HUD & Tactile Lab Glass

entry_surfaces./: holographic HUD split — interactive reactive core orb + telemetry grid left, floating glass cards & live dialogue stream right
entry_surfaces./auth: biometric lockscreen — facial camera HUD reticle + wake phrase voice listener with bypass command code

visual_enhancers.grid_overlay: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.03) 0px, transparent 1px, transparent 32px), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.03) 0px, transparent 1px, transparent 32px)
visual_enhancers.corner_brackets: before:absolute before:top-0 before:left-0 before:w-3 before:h-3 before:border-t-2 before:border-l-2 before:border-cyan-400 after:absolute after:bottom-0 after:right-0 after:w-3 after:h-3 after:border-b-2 after:border-r-2 after:border-cyan-400

hud_textures.description: HUD tactical interface control panel backdrop layer with low opacity
Cyan glowing concentric rings HUD overlay for facial scanner and core orb

ReactiveOrbCanvas.description: HTML5 Canvas rendering multi-layered particle waveform orb in neon cyan (#00F0FF). Scales dynamically (1.0x to 1.45x) and increases particle velocity and turbulence when Web Speech API / TTS audio plays or user speaks.

FaceScannerModal.description: HUD biometric lock screen. Accesses getUserMedia, renders targeting brackets, scanline sweep, neural mesh overlay, sends frame verification to Gemini Vision simulation or test bypass, emits [FACE_VERIFIED: TRUE].

VoiceWakeController.description: Web Speech API / SpeechRecognition listener for 'NEXUS, bom dia' and follow-up prompts. Includes visual soundwave indicator, microphone toggle, and manual prompt input fallback.

FloatingCardStream.description: Staggered glassmorphic animated cards appearing sequentially based on Gemini tags: [CARD_CLIMA] (Novorizonte-MG), [CARD_AGENDA] (Daily schedule/reminders), [CARD_EMAILS] (VIP messages), [CARD_NOTICIAS] (G1/BBC filtered: Saúde, LGBTQIA+, Política, Tecnologia), [CARD_SAUDE] (Biometrics & hydration metrics).

NexusDialogueFeed.description: Terminal stream displaying NEXUS speech transcripts with typewriter effect, polite tone addressing the user as 'Senhor', subtle witty sarcasm, and Web Speech Synthesis (SpeechSynthesisUtterance) voice output in Portuguese.

MemoryTimelineDrawer.description: Persistent briefing archive and memory log powered by MongoDB. Allows querying past briefings, system logs, and executive summary transcripts.

desktop_composition.left_column: col-span-12 lg:col-span-5 flex flex-col items-center justify-between p-6 border-r border-cyan-500/20 relative
desktop_composition.right_column: col-span-12 lg:col-span-7 flex flex-col p-6 space-y-6 overflow-y-auto max-h-[calc(100vh-80px)]
desktop_composition.header_hud: h-16 border-b border-cyan-500/20 px-6 flex items-center justify-between backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-950/80 sticky top-0 z-50
desktop_composition.bottom_dock: h-20 border-t border-cyan-500/20 px-6 flex items-center justify-between backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-950/90 sticky bottom-0 z-40

motion.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion: disable particle turbulence and orbital rotation, fall back to smooth opacity fades

animations.card_stagger_entrance: motion.div with opacity: 0 -> 1, y: 30 -> 0, transition: { duration: 0.45, ease: 'easeOut' }
animations.hud_glitch_flash: opacity variations between 0.92 and 1.0 on new system messages

accessibility.wcag_compliance: WCAG AA / APCA standards met. Text on glass surfaces uses dark underlays (bg-slate-950/75+) ensuring > 4.5:1 contrast against cyan-100/slate-200 text
accessibility.aria_labels: All HUD buttons, camera inputs, audio synthesizers, and modal switches have explicit aria-label and role attributes
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Full tab index support and shortcut hotkeys (e.g. Space to speak, 'B' for briefing, 'M' for memory drawer, 'Esc' to dismiss)

instructions_to_main_agent: Mount the dark holographic interface in /app/frontend/src/App.tsx with route paths: '/' (Main HUD command center), '/auth' (Biometric Face Lockscreen), '/timeline' (Memory archives), '/settings' (API & Voice controls).
Ensure dark mode is permanent by having class='dark' on <html> in index.html, with deep obsidian background #030712.

Implement the Brazilian Portuguese conversational persona: NEXUS must always address the user respectfully as 'Senhor', maintain a calm, refined, subtly witty tone, and generate crisp spoken summaries.
Support live live Web Speech API recognition (with graceful fallback to typed command) and Web Speech Synthesis in pt-BR.

Connect Gemini 2.5 Flash via FastAPI backend for synthesizing RSS news (Saúde, LGBTQIA+, Política, Tecnologia), Novorizonte-MG weather, and financial quotes, returning the exact tagged protocol format: [FACE_VERIFIED: TRUE], [CARD_CLIMA], [CARD_AGENDA], [CARD_EMAILS], [CARD_NOTICIAS], [CARD_SAUDE].
Persist all conversations and briefing events to MongoDB via Motor async queries in backend/lib/db.py.
Assign role-based data-testid attributes to all buttons, mic controls, dialogue texts, and cards for automated testing.
